title: fix(fields): only a real boolean is a value of a boolean cell — a non-boolean scalar drew a checked box
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#8582

## What

`BooleanCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) read every non-boolean scalar by truthiness. The string `'false'`, the string `'0'` and `{}` drew a **checked**, disabled checkbox (a completion field its green "Completed" indicator; an `active`-style field skipped its "Off" badge) — an affirmative answer the record never gave — while `0` and `''` drew an **unchecked** box (a status field its "Off" badge), a `false` the record never stored either. The guard is now `typeof value !== 'boolean'`: only a real boolean is a value of a boolean column; everything else renders the shared `EmptyValue` affordance. A real `true` / `false` renders exactly as before.

## Why this reading — the spec decided it, on four instruments

The card and the dispatch brief listed three readings (a declared truth table / only real booleans / surface the raw text) and asked for `@objectstack/spec` to be read first. It settles the question:

1. `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`, `valueSchemaFor`: the `boolean` / `toggle` arm is a bare `z.boolean()` — the runtime value contract admits nothing else.
2. Same file, `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES`: "Value is a JS boolean on the wire (driver read-coercion repairs SQL 0/1)" — the `0`/`1` repair is assigned to the driver. objectql implements it: `coerceBooleanFields` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`) runs on the engine's read-presentation paths (`engine.ts`: result rows and hook contexts).
3. Same file, `NON_TEXT_STORED_VALUE_TYPES`: a boolean column's stored value "is never text on any backend" — `'true'` / `'false'` are never a stored boolean.
4. The truth table already lives at the ingest boundaries, once per boundary: objectql's write-path validator accepts the six spellings and refuses the rest with `invalid_boolean`; `packages/rest/src/import-coerce.ts` `parseBooleanCell` reads the spec's `IMPORT_BOOLEAN_TRUE_TOKENS` / `IMPORT_BOOLEAN_FALSE_TOKENS` and refuses `'maybe'` / `2` with `invalid_boolean`.

So a non-boolean that reaches this renderer is a producer that skipped its repair. Reading 1 (a renderer-side truth table) would be a second copy of an instrument the platform already owns at the producer — the renderer-side dialect AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids. Reading 3 (raw text) would invent an affordance no renderer in this file has; the file's own convention for a value it cannot read as its type is already `EmptyValue` (`DateTimeCellRenderer` for an unparseable date). Reading 2 is what the spec says, and it is the same statement objectui#8490 made for `[]`: "No value" is a statement about the field's TYPE — the record holds no boolean here.

**Declared, not smoothed.** `{}` and `'false'` now land on the same affordance for the same reason, and neither is "checked". The affordance does not say WHICH wrong-typed value the column holds; the platform's instrument for surfacing that is the write-path refusal, not the read renderer. One legitimate path was checked and excluded: a dataset measure over a boolean field yields a number, but `packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts` formats it as text and never routes through `getCellRenderer`, so no number reaches this renderer by design. A consumer with a backend of its own that fed this renderer `1` / `0` or `'true'` / `'false'` now sees the affordance instead of a box; the changeset says to coerce at the data source, where the platform does.

## Before / after (measured by rendering on `2a38862f5`, the objectui#8490 head this branch started from)

| stored value | before | now |
|---|---|---|
| `'false'`, `'0'`, `'no'`, `{}` | checked checkbox | affordance |
| `'false'` on `completed` | green "Completed" indicator | affordance |
| `'false'` on `active` | checked checkbox, no "Off" badge | affordance |
| `0`, `''` | unchecked checkbox | affordance |
| `0` on `active` | destructive "Active — Off" badge | affordance |
| `'true'`, `'1'`, `1` (spellings an ingest boundary accepts) | checked checkbox | affordance — the renderer owns no truth table |
| `true` / `false` | checked / unchecked (indicator, badge by field name) | **unchanged** |
| `null`, `undefined`, `[]` | affordance (objectui#8490) | affordance, unchanged |

## Files

- `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` — the guard; `value === false` for the badge; `checked={value}`. `isEmptyMultiValue`'s docblock loses its boolean caller (the `typeof` guard answers `[]` for the same reason).
- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/booleanCell.nonBooleanScalar-8582.test.tsx` — new, 29 cases.
- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.fabricatedValue-8490.test.tsx` — the one pin that recorded "a scalar `0` still draws an unchecked box by truthiness" now records that the two rulings agree at their seam; its header sentence about untouched scalar coercions points here.
- `content/docs/fields/boolean.mdx` — the "Cell Renderer" section claimed green/gray badges while the renderer has drawn a disabled checkbox (indicator / badge by field name); replaced with what it draws and the ruling (AGENTS.md #2). The stale badge claim was pre-existing and is corrected in place because it is the very section this change alters.
- `.changeset/8582-boolean-cell-non-boolean-scalar.md` — `@object-ui/fields` patch.

## Evidence — the legs were run, not predicted

All legs ran on commit `09fab31d1` (the fix commit). objectui#8490 landed on `main` as `21529629c` while this branch was in flight, so `main` was merged into the head as `32c4398ab` (no force-push); the merge carries the same five blobs, verified per file by `git rev-parse`. Each leg: mutate on disk → prove the mutation (injected-text count, deleted-text count, LINE TOTAL, blob hash) → run `pnpm exec vitest run` on the 8582 and 8490 files from the repo root → restore with `git checkout HEAD -- path` and prove it BY STATE (`git hash-object` equals `git rev-parse HEAD:path` AND `git diff HEAD` empty), trapped on `EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths. Harness-death signatures (`Cannot read properties of null`, `Unable to find`, `TypeError`, `is not a function`) are counted separately from `AssertionError` lines.

| B — the caricature (`value !== true`) | injected 1, `typeof` guard 0, 3421 lines (= HEAD), blob `fc5afba…` not HEAD's | 6 failed / 52 passed | ONLY "must still draw its checkbox" (`false` on boolean and toggle), "must still draw its Off badge", "must still draw its Not-completed indicator" — every THE DEFECT / THE OTHER DIRECTION / THE RULING case passed, which is exactly why the populated `false` block is load-bearing | 0 |

Every discriminating assertion was observed to fail in the leg it was written for. (The sentence "the renderer owns no truth table" also heads a `describe` block, so its raw occurrence count includes title echoes; the mode reading is unaffected.)

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/booleanCell.nonBooleanScalar-8582.test.tsx packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.fabricatedValue-8490.test.tsx` — 2 files, 58 passed, `vitest exit=0` (exit captured by redirect, never through a pipe).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` — both programs (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/fields^...'`, 9 tasks) — `type-check exit=0`, script name echoed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/ packages/plugin-grid/` — 257 files, 3464 tests passed, `vitest exit=0`, 467 s.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields lint` — 0 errors (937 pre-existing warnings; the new file's are the same `as any` cast the 8490 suite carries).
- Gates: `check:control-bytes` OK (6772 files); `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-fixed` OK; `check:doc-fences` OK; a Python scanner for control and zero-width code points over the five changed files: 0 hits, lit control fires (the brief is right that `grep -P` with a wide `\x{}` class fails outright on this container).
- The ratchet re-run on the merge head `32c4398ab`: the same two files, 58 passed (29 + 29, verbose reporter), `vitest exit=0`; `type-check exit=0` on both programs.

**Declared narrowing.** `turbo ls --affected` (base `2a38862f5`) lists 20 packages. Run locally: `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` (the read-mode cell consumer). Declared to CI: the other 18 (`app-shell`, `console`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-view`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-designer`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-report`, `runner`, `site`, three examples). Checkable reason: the only behaviour that moved is what this renderer draws for a NON-boolean input, so a consumer test can turn red only if it feeds one; a census over every test file in the affected packages that declares a `boolean` / `toggle` field (48 files) found 4 fixtures assigning a non-boolean to such a key, all in `app-shell` metadata-admin — three JSON-schema `schema: {}` fragments and one summary filter's `billable: ''` form value — none rendered by a read-mode cell renderer (the lit control fired on a synthetic `is_active: 1`). `check:doc-snippets` is NOT MEASURED locally (it exits 2 asking for a scoped 34-package build; this diff removes one `ts` fence from `boolean.mdx` and adds none).

No exported type changed (`BooleanCellRenderer`'s signature is the same), so no cross-package `.d.ts` reverse check applies.

## Out of scope

- Filed as objectstack-ai/objectui#8593: `BooleanField`'s readonly branch (`packages/fields/src/widgets/BooleanField.tsx`) reads the value by truthiness too — `'false'` says "Yes". Same class, different surface, its own test suite; not taken here.
- Observed, not filed: `packages/app-shell/src/utils/auditHistoryDisplay.ts` `formatScalar` keeps a private three-spelling table (`true`, `'true'`, `1`); whether audit rows ever carry a pre-coercion spelling is a census question for triage.
